---
title: "ダッシュボード"
subtitle: "Zotero の読書リスト（ローカル専用・公開されません）"
toc: false
---

```{=html}
<style>
.dash-stats {
  display: flex;
  gap: 0;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--rule-strong);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule);
  margin: 1rem 0 2rem;
}
.dash-stat {
  flex: 1;
  padding: 1rem 0.5rem;
  text-align: center;
  cursor: pointer;
  border-left: 1px solid var(--rule);
  transition: background 0.2s ease;
}
.dash-stat:first-child { border-left: none; }
.dash-stat:hover { background: var(--code-bg); }
.dash-stat.active .dash-stat-num { color: var(--vermilion); }
.dash-stat-num {
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-size: 1.9rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  line-height: 1.2;
}
.dash-stat-label {
  font-family: var(--font-label);
  font-size: 0.68rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0.14em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--ink-faint);
}
.dash-search {
  width: 100%;
  font-family: var(--font-body);
  font-size: 0.92rem;
  color: var(--ink);
  background: transparent;
  border: none;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule);
  padding: 0.5rem 0;
  margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
  outline: none;
}
.dash-search:focus { border-bottom-color: var(--vermilion); }
.dash-item {
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule);
  padding: 1.3rem 0;
}
.dash-item-title {
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-size: 1.08rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  line-height: 1.6;
  margin-bottom: 0.25rem;
}
.dash-item-title a { color: var(--ink); text-decoration: none; }
.dash-item-title a:hover { color: var(--vermilion); }
.dash-item-meta {
  font-size: 0.82rem;
  color: var(--ink-soft);
}
.dash-item-tags {
  margin-top: 0.5rem;
  display: flex;
  gap: 0.45rem;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;
}
.dash-tag {
  font-family: var(--font-label);
  font-size: 0.64rem;
  font-weight: 500;
  letter-spacing: 0.1em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--ink-faint);
  border: 1px solid var(--rule);
  padding: 0.2em 0.7em;
}
.dash-tag.status-to-read  { color: var(--vermilion); border-color: var(--vermilion); }
.dash-tag.status-reading  { color: var(--ink); border-color: var(--ink-soft); }
.dash-links {
  font-family: var(--font-label);
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.06em;
  margin-left: auto;
}
.dash-links a { color: var(--ink-faint); text-decoration: none; margin-left: 0.9rem; }
.dash-links a:hover { color: var(--vermilion); }
.dash-empty {
  border: 1px dashed var(--rule);
  padding: 1.6rem;
  color: var(--ink-soft);
  font-size: 0.9rem;
}
</style>

<div id="dash-root"></div>

<script>
(async function () {
  const rootEl = document.getElementById("dash-root");
  let data = null;
  try {
    const res = await fetch("library.json", { cache: "no-store" });
    if (res.ok) data = await res.json();
  } catch (e) {}

  if (!data) {
    rootEl.innerHTML =
      '<div class="dash-empty">まだデータがありません。Zotero の Better BibTeX で ' +
      '<code>dashboard/library.json</code> への自動エクスポート' +
      '（形式: BetterBibTeX JSON）を設定してください。</div>';
    return;
  }

  // BetterBibTeX JSON ({items: [...]}) と CSL JSON ([...]) の両対応
  const items = (Array.isArray(data) ? data : data.items || []).map((it) => {
    const tags = (it.tags || []).map((t) => (typeof t === "string" ? t : t.tag));
    const creators = it.creators
      ? it.creators.map((c) => c.lastName || c.name).filter(Boolean)
      : (it.author || []).map((a) => a.family || a.literal).filter(Boolean);
    const year =
      (it.date || "").match(/\d{4}/)?.[0] ||
      it.issued?.["date-parts"]?.[0]?.[0] || "";
    const status = ["to-read", "reading", "done"].find((s) => tags.includes(s)) || "その他";
    return {
      title: it.title || "(no title)",
      authors: creators.join(", "),
      year: String(year),
      venue: it.publicationTitle || it["container-title"] || "",
      tags,
      status,
      added: it.dateAdded || it.accessed || "",
      citekey: it.citationKey || it.id || "",
      url: it.url || it.URL || (it.DOI ? "https://doi.org/" + it.DOI : ""),
    };
  });

  items.sort((a, b) => (b.added || "").localeCompare(a.added || ""));

  const STATUSES = [
    ["to-read", "未読"],
    ["reading", "読書中"],
    ["done", "読了"],
    ["all", "すべて"],
  ];
  let activeStatus = "to-read";
  let query = "";

  function count(s) {
    return s === "all" ? items.length : items.filter((i) => i.status === s).length;
  }

  function esc(t) {
    return t.replace(/&/g, "&amp;").replace(/</g, "&lt;").replace(/>/g, "&gt;");
  }

  function render() {
    const visible = items.filter((i) => {
      const okStatus = activeStatus === "all" || i.status === activeStatus;
      const q = query.toLowerCase();
      const okQuery =
        !q || (i.title + " " + i.authors + " " + i.venue).toLowerCase().includes(q);
      return okStatus && okQuery;
    });

    const stats = STATUSES.map(
      ([key, label]) =>
        '<div class="dash-stat' + (key === activeStatus ? " active" : "") +
        '" data-status="' + key + '">' +
        '<div class="dash-stat-num">' + count(key) + "</div>" +
        '<div class="dash-stat-label">' + label + "</div></div>"
    ).join("");

    const list = visible.length
      ? visible.map((i) => {
          const meta = [i.authors, i.year, i.venue].filter(Boolean).join(" ・ ");
          const zoteroLink = i.citekey
            ? '<a href="zotero://select/items/@' + esc(i.citekey) + '">Zotero</a>'
            : "";
          const urlLink = i.url ? '<a href="' + esc(i.url) + '" target="_blank">原文</a>' : "";
          const tags = i.tags
            .map((t) => '<span class="dash-tag status-' + esc(t) + '">' + esc(t) + "</span>")
            .join("");
          return (
            '<div class="dash-item">' +
            '<div class="dash-item-title">' +
            (i.url ? '<a href="' + esc(i.url) + '" target="_blank">' + esc(i.title) + "</a>" : esc(i.title)) +
            "</div>" +
            '<div class="dash-item-meta">' + esc(meta) + "</div>" +
            '<div class="dash-item-tags">' + tags +
            '<span class="dash-links">' + zoteroLink + urlLink + "</span></div></div>"
          );
        }).join("")
      : '<div class="dash-empty">該当する論文はありません。</div>';

    rootEl.innerHTML =
      '<div class="dash-stats">' + stats + "</div>" +
      '<input class="dash-search" type="search" placeholder="タイトル・著者・掲載誌で検索" value="' +
      esc(query) + '">' + list;

    rootEl.querySelectorAll(".dash-stat").forEach((el) =>
      el.addEventListener("click", () => {
        activeStatus = el.dataset.status;
        render();
      })
    );
    const search = rootEl.querySelector(".dash-search");
    search.addEventListener("input", (e) => {
      query = e.target.value;
      render();
    });
  }

  render();
})();
</script>
```
